crafting_currency_omens: Alchemy = Orb of Alchemy affix targeting
Annulment = Orb of Annulment removal targeting
utility_omens: Answered Prayers, Secret Compartments, the Hunt, Reinforcements = encounter modifiers
restrictions: Only one omen of each type can be active at a time
Most obtained from Ritual encounters via Tribute
Some (Abyssal Omens) drop from Abyss content
Omens must be right-clicked to activate, then remain in inventory until triggered
